Title: Unprotected Direct Table Insert Fallback in Telemetry
Impact: Anonymous users could bypass RPC validation and inject arbitrary rows into site_analytics
Recommended Fix: Enforce RPC-only insertion (track_resource_event) and validate session ID length (8-100 chars)

Title: Sub-Admin Creation Lacks Automatic Rollback on DB Insert Failure
Impact: Failed profile inserts leave orphaned auth.users accounts without permissions
Recommended Fix: Call auth.admin.deleteUser(newUserId) if admin_profiles or permissions insertion fails

Title: Missing Rate Limiting on Authentication and Edge Functions
Impact: Brute-force password guessing or edge function exhaustion
Recommended Fix: Deploy Cloudflare WAF / Upstash rate limit on auth & admin edge functions

Title: Client-Side Telemetry Aggregation Limited by PostgREST 1000-Row Default
Impact: Top resources metrics truncated or inaccurate when site analytics exceed 1000 rows
Recommended Fix: Replace client-side map with server-side SQL function get_top_learning_resources

Title: Fragmented SQL Migration Files Without Version Control Tool
Impact: Risk of schema drift or out-of-order execution in staging/prod environments
Recommended Fix: Consolidate SQL scripts into Supabase CLI or Flyway versioned migration scripts

Title: Inconsistent Enum Casing in Resource Type Mapping
Impact: Potential filter mismatch between storage object paths and UI filter queries
Recommended Fix: Standardize ResourceType definitions across storage utilities and admin components

Title: Legacy Table Redundancy (admin_users vs admin_profiles)
Impact: Schema confusion and redundant queries across auth contexts
Recommended Fix: Deprecate admin_users table and standardize foreign key constraints to auth.users

Title: Monolithic JS Bundle Exceeds 600 KB Without Code-Splitting
Impact: Slow initial page load time on low-bandwidth mobile networks
Recommended Fix: Implement React.lazy dynamic imports for admin sections and standalone pages

Title: Absence of Automated Test Suite
Impact: High risk of regressions during refactoring or schema updates
Recommended Fix: Add Vitest unit tests for storage/auth utilities and Playwright E2E tests

Title: Missing ARIA Dialog Properties and Focus Trap in Modals
Impact: Impaired screen reader navigation and keyboard focus traps

Title: Console Logging Without APM Error Aggregation
Impact: Unmonitored client errors and missing error alerting in production
Recommended Fix: Integrate Sentry SDK for client error capturing and APM metrics

Title: SessionStorage Telemetry Without Cookie Privacy Banner
Impact: Potential non-compliance with student privacy guidelines
Recommended Fix: Add clear privacy notice explaining anonymous session telemetry usage
